ui_bugs.issue: For a soft-deleted customer opened from the Deleted tab, the header status badge still renders 'Active' (green) instead of 'Deleted' — the toolbar correctly toggles Delete→Restore, but the badge doesn't reflect the deleted state. Cosmetic; does not block the restore flow.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' coming from /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/people/ui.jsx Pager <select> — the option label wraps children in a <span>. Non-blocking but pollutes console and can break SSR hydration.

action_items: (LOW) In Person360, when person.deleted_at is set, render the status Pill as 'Deleted' (red/amber) instead of 'active' — keep the Restore button behaviour that already works.
(LOW) Fix ui.jsx Pager: remove the inner <span> inside <option> elements to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PeopleList.jsx bulk delete uses window.confirm() — works but is a browser-native modal (inconsistent with the app's shadcn confirm-dialog style used elsewhere like Person360 delete). Consider replacing with a styled AlertDialog for consistency.
In PeopleList.jsx line 141 (toggleRow) uses `n.has(id) ? n.delete(id) : n.add(id)` as an expression — works but eslint no-unused-expressions could flag; a plain if/else would be cleaner.
Selection state is reset on tab/filter/page change (good), but not on role change alone — currently included in deps; ok.
